nisra.source: Department of Health (Northern Ireland), published by NISRA

rows.name: Proportion of P1 children who are obese
Proportion of P1 children who are overweight or obese
Proportion of Y8 children who are obese
Proportion of Y8 children who are overweight or obese

nisra.note: Aggregate measurements of Primary 1 and Year 8 pupils, classified using International Obesity Task Force growth charts. P1 pupils were aged 4 years 2 months to 6 years 2 months; Year 8 pupils 11 years 2 months to 13 years 2 months. Pandemic-related missing years and incomplete trust coverage limit historical comparisons. See the publisher methodology before comparing years or areas.

assembly_divisions.attribution: Contains Parliamentary information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0.
assembly_divisions.note: Previous complete calendar month in Europe/London. Counts recorded divisions, not every vote, motion, sitting or enacted law. Recess months can have zero divisions. Subjects, member names and individual votes are not copied.

pharmacies.attribution: NHS Business Services Authority, Pharmacy Openings and Closures, NHSBSA Open Data
pharmacies.note: Pharmacies on NHS England Pharmaceutical Lists providing NHS prescriptions and pharmaceutical services. Stocks are at month end; openings, closures and net changes cover that calendar month. Ownership changes count as a closure and an opening. Backdated amendments and group changes can affect comparisons between releases. Counts are premises, not patients or prescription volumes.

vehicle_fleet.attribution: Source: the Ministry of Transport and licensed by the Ministry of Transport for re-use under CC BY 4.0.
vehicle_fleet.release: Annual Motor Vehicle Fleet Statistics 2024, published October/November 2025
vehicle_fleet.note: Published annual fleet composition, table 1.1; not a live vehicle-register count. Ministry categories differ from NZTA classifications. This table includes Other; Total light overlaps the passenger and commercial categories. Do not add subtotals to component categories. Vehicles exempt from licensing and restoration licences are excluded. This is the explicitly dated 2024 release, not a claim that newer releases cannot exist.

road_traffic.source: Transport Scotland; Department for Transport estimates
road_traffic.note: Calendar-year distance travelled on Scottish roads, not the number of vehicles or road length. Table 5.1. Minor-road estimates since 2000 have been revised following benchmarking; totals may differ from sums because of rounding. Motorways include A(M) roads. The total overlaps all three component categories. This reader uses the explicitly named 2025 publication.

rows.coverage: Annual total excluding untypical and undisclosed transactions
Annual total excluding untypical and undisclosed transactions
Annual total excluding untypical and undisclosed transactions

land_transaction_tax.note: Tax due by effective financial year, not cash receipts, property values or transaction counts. The inclusive annual total includes transactions whose details are restricted; the other three measures exclude untypical and undisclosed transactions. They overlap and must not be added. No confidential components are inferred. Values are publisher-rounded and may be revised, including for higher-rate refunds. Latest available completed financial year in this dataset; unchanged annual totals are not daily-stale.

scotland.note: Calendar-month registered company insolvencies, not seasonally adjusted. Five procedure counts sum to the total; do not add the total again. Moratoriums, restructuring plans and administration-to-CVL conversions are separate series and are not added. Counts are administrative events, not individual people, insolvency rates or forecasts. Monthly statistics may be revised. England-and-Wales combined figures are not relabelled as either nation.

northern-ireland.note: Calendar-month registered company insolvencies, not seasonally adjusted. Five procedure counts sum to the total; do not add the total again. Moratoriums, restructuring plans and administration-to-CVL conversions are separate series and are not added. Counts are administrative events, not individual people, insolvency rates or forecasts. Monthly statistics may be revised. England-and-Wales combined figures are not relabelled as either nation.

notification_state.new_release: NZ electricity reader repaired: five period-48 prices retain independently corroborated values and now expose interim status, units, geography, exact interval and source. All 240 selected specimen cells match separate official reports. All previous validated sources preserved.
notification_state.known_unresolved: ABS 403, ONS 403/429, legislation 404, StatCan 406, delayed RFS snapshot; intermittent TfL 429 already known. TfL snapshot status can fluctuate within the acknowledged intermittent-throttling baseline; see source_status_changes.
notification_state.policy: Notify only meaningful new failures, sustained recoveries, validated-data regressions or required user action. Unchanged monthly/annual values are not stale. Do not repeat known alerts.

investigations.outcome: Transient timeout; fresh production read recovered. No persistent regression or user action.

nz_price_verification.independence_limit: Independent Python extraction of separate official report; shared underlying publisher pricing system. No independent market recalculation.
